intent: Make the simulation the primary teaching surface; separate experiment selection, execution, settings and interpretation.

desktop.settings: Grouped primary controls, robot/scene parameters and secondary tuning
desktop.reading: Observation and discussion below the workspace; assumptions/sources collapsed

tablet: Compact experiment selector; simulation and settings remain side by side when space allows.
mobile: Experiment selector, heading, simulation and playback, results, settings, then reading. No long controls panel before the simulation.

visual_language.brand: Existing Intro2AV navy, blue and cyan
visual_language.surfaces: White, light borders and restrained corners

preserve: All algorithm behaviors and input IDs
checks: Keyboard navigation and visible active experiment
Canvas aspect ratio and click coordinate mapping

implementation_refinements.focus_view: Expands canvas and hides navigation/settings; automatically exits at phone/tablet widths.
implementation_refinements.labels: Keep canvas annotations legible as the canvas narrows; maintain its aspect ratio and click coordinate mapping.
